p.Text: More Duelists have died attempting to Attune to Voltaic than to any other Core. It does not wait to be chosen. It chooses, once, in an instant, and offers no second.
No scholar has ever catalogued Zephyr's resting place twice in the same season. It is the only Core that appears to wander — or perhaps it is the world around it that fails to stay still.
The stone beneath every threshold in this place remembers being closer to Terra than to open air. Some scholars believe the Core has never moved at all — that the world moved around it instead.
Umbra keeps no monument of its own choosing. This one stands only because a Duelist insisted the Core deserved to be remembered as more than an absence.
Toxin does not attack so much as it waits. Where the Sundering left the ground bare, Toxin's Echoes are already the first thing found growing back.
Where Pyro betrays itself by its own light, Cryo conceals. The scholars did not find their first shard of it; it was brought to them, frozen inside the body of an animal that had wandered too near.
The first scholar to bond with Radiant never dueled. She spent her Attunement building the first shelter for those who had none — this Hub's oldest wall is said to be hers.
Of the eight, Pyro was the first Core the scholars ever recovered — not because it was nearest, but because it could not stay hidden. A Core that burns gives itself away.

Volcanic battle plate: obsidian shards split by molten cracks; Neon cores in the main cracks; ember drift off both pauldrons. Pyro-locked palette (literal hexes: no Element colourways). (2026-10-29, the owner: wearable by every Element -- Element None; its colours stay Pyro's)

Ice-monarch robe / cloak hybrid: crystal-crown collar, crystal pauldrons, crossing lapels with a crystal brooch, short pleated cloak with icicle dags, robe panels on the thighs. (2026-10-29, the owner: wearable by every Element -- Element None; its colours stay its own)

Standalone (fixed palette, no @Element roles: every colourway is identical; 'element' only picks the preview body). Battle-worn plate over a ragged crimson surcoat; comic bites, impact bursts, gashes and one blackened lame. No Glow, no particles.

Standalone fixed palette (crimson / onyx / gold / wine), no Element roles: identical on every Element (the Element field is nominal, the preview body only). Harlequin doublet, pleated crown ruff, short dagged cape, motley counterchange, bell-tipped points. One faint gold glint (BellGlint) on the left collar bell; no Glow.

Sleek violet-and-gold storm-sovereign jacket: a lightning-bolt crossover closure, bolt seams down the arms and thighs (real inset grooves with thin Neon strips laid in them -- the only Glow), gold epaulettes with a lightning fringe, mandarin collar, swallowtails with a lightning hem, riding boots. Thin tight shells (0.035 / 0.042). Worn with the short skinned ThunderRegaliaCape (Back) and the ThunderRegaliaCirclet (Hat).

Bulky Terra tank armour: broad two-tier stone pauldrons, a thick slab breastplate, wide stepped tasset guards, keeled greaves, a masonry back, over a root-bark under-suit. Hand-placed low-poly moss + green crystal clusters climb the left side to the helm (VerdantWardenHelm). No Glow, no particles.

Standalone (fixed palette, no @Element roles: every colourway is identical; 'element' only picks the preview body). Tight shinobi gi (0.014 stand-off), crossover front, bandolier with pouch / kunai / buckle, oxblood sash under a pouched utility belt, wraps, one gunmetal pauldron (right), hidden-blade bracer (right), holster (right thigh), dagger (left thigh), boot knife (left), split-toe tabi. Cloak + hood are separate accessories. No Glow, no particles.

Standalone (fixed palette, no @Element roles: every colourway is identical; 'element' only picks the preview body). Sci-fi flight suit: navy pressure suit, off-white hard shells with low raised seams, gunmetal hardware, starfall-orange piping/stripes, the falling-star motif; greebles at chest / forearms / back; tiny Neon indicator lights only. No particles. Head-piece: Acc_Hat_StarfallVoyagerHelm.

p.Value: Radiant staff A (Phase 5, 2026-09-29): Body + Lines MeshParts imported from vmarm/radiant/phase5/staff/staff_A_body.fbx and staff_A_lines.fbx (1 m = 1 stud; grip = origin, +Y long axis, -Z front face). RadiantAnim clones these (Config.AssetPaths); OriginFromPivot / TemplateSize / P_* per staff_A_manifest.json. Body: SmoothPlastic, white (Color multiplies the vertex colours). Lines: the engraving, idle #B9A46A SmoothPlastic, Neon gold at runtime (RadiantDraw.StaffGlow).
